summary: Practise customs classification, valuation checks, and clearance documentation. Explore the course and its practical work products.
lede: Customs training helps clearance and trade operations professionals prepare reviewable declaration files and resolve document gaps. Participants practise Harmonized System classification, checking invoices and transport records, tracing valuation and origin evidence, and recording queries and handoffs. Exercises use worksheets, checklists, exception logs, and workflow maps that can be adapted to organizational procedures.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who prepare, review, coordinate, or oversee customs clearance records and declaration handoffs.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with commercial invoices, packing lists, and transport documents will help you take part in the exercises. No coding is required. Bring a laptop with Excel; no additional software installation or personal account is required. Exercises use worked examples rather than a provided software lab or dataset.
